about: Mod authors HMG-API knows, by author key UUID. A mod from a key not listed here still installs, with a warning; updates to any installed mod must come from the key it was first installed with. To be listed, add your mod to the catalogue (catalog/, tools/catalog.py add; see the wiki's Making mods page): that pull request lists your key here.
